title: 002 高深莫测的老板
content_zh:
江南霹雳堂雷家世代研制杀伤力极大的火药，早年先祖曾行“封刀挂剑”仪式，立志摒弃这武林中最常用的两件兵器，而专注火器研究，以此走出一条完全不一样的路。当年，没有人觉得一个不用刀剑的世家能够存活下去。但是霹雳堂雷家做到了，他们已经将火药完全地变成了一种兵器，将不可能之事变成可能，成为了武林中令人听之便生之敬畏的绝顶世家。
“既然得罪了霹雳堂，我们也知道此事无法善了了，纵然不是敌手，我们也总不能束手待毙！”为首大汉心知霹雳堂的人对于得罪他们的人从不手下留情，心中一横，握紧了手中的刀。
雷无桀笑着摇了摇头：“刚刚我只是在那位兄台的刀上洒下了几粒霹雳子，如果你们再敢无理，那么我就在你们身上……”
“上！”为首大汉手上大刀一挥，那十数个一拥而上。
“你们！”雷无桀瞪大了眼睛，“难道一点都不怕么？”
三柄刀已经同时朝着雷无桀的头劈了下来。
雷无桀大怒，双拳向上一挥，竟一拳劈断了三柄钢刀，震得那三人飞了出去。
“好厉害的火药！”众人大惊。
雷无桀怒道：“不是火药，是我的无方拳法！当然，如果你们想要看火药的话……”雷无桀一跃而起，手上黑光一闪，数粒弹珠已经被他洒了下去。
只听到几声巨响，那些大汉一个个被炸得飞了起来，再倒地之时，却是血流不止，站也站不起来了。
雷无桀悠然然地从空中落下，双手负在身后：“怎样？现在可
那几个大汉闻言一怔，相互对视了几眼，他们本以为这少年必定会取了他们性命，可听这语气，似乎倒是放了他们一命。
“还不滚！”雷无桀皱了皱眉头，在他预想中，这帮人此时应该屁滚尿流仓皇而逃，可怎地一副赖着不走的样子。
大汉们闻言急忙勉力站了起来，一个个扶着彼此逃也似地跑了出去。
雷无桀很满意地点点头，从一堆桌椅的废墟中找出了自己的包裹，背上后便也准备离去。可一只手拦住了他。
雷无桀抬头，看到那个面目俊秀的老板，全身慵懒地缩在狐裘之中，只伸出一只右手，懒洋洋慢悠悠地挥了起来，拦住了雷无桀的去路。
雷无桀急忙抱手：“大恩不言谢！路见不平，拔刀相助本就是应该的！便不用太客气了，我着急赶路，还望后会有期！”
萧瑟眯起了眼睛，皱了皱眉头：“大恩？不言谢？拔刀相助？”
雷无桀也甚是困惑：“要不是我，那帮大汉早已经抢了你的店，甚至说不好连你们的命也没了。难道不是大恩？”
萧瑟挥手指了指那堆废墟，怒道：“你仔细看看！”

雷无桀转身望去，只见大厅里大大小小十几张桌子被炸得七零八落，几个小二也被砸得头破血流，连地上都被炸出了几个坑。
萧瑟指了指那堆废墟，忿忿不平：“你看我这店，被砸了又有什么两样！至于刚刚那些人，想要我的命？哼！”
“这……”雷无桀满脸通红，竟一时不知该如何是好。
“一百两银子。”萧瑟冲着雷无桀伸出了手，那双手洁白无瑕，五指修长，可在雷无桀看来，却比刚才那些大汉们的钢刀要可怖多了。
“我没钱！”雷无桀退了一步。
“哦？”萧瑟的狐裘微微抖了一抖，他轻轻一挥手，整个客栈的门在瞬间合上了。
“这功夫……”雷无桀终于也不得不承认，刚才那些人似乎真的奈何不了这位高深莫测的老板。
“但是我马上就能有这笔钱了！”雷无桀忽然想起了什么，眼睛一亮，斩钉截铁地说。
“哦？”萧瑟依旧还是懒洋洋地应着，可眼睛已经不由自主地盯着雷无桀的那个大包袱上下打量了。
雷无桀继续说道：“我马上要去一个地方了，到了那个地方，我便有钱了？”
“什么地方？”
“雪月城！”雷无桀傲然道。
“雪月城？”萧瑟闻言也是一惊。雪月城不是江湖中传统的门派，它更像是一个联盟，一个由天下几大门派、各大世家共同建立起来的一个组织！自有雪月城出现的那一天起，整个江湖的规矩，便由它来定了。而各大世家门派中的年轻子弟，很多都会前往雪月城就学，因为多年经营，雪月城俨然成为了独立的一方势力，它教的不仅有别的门派没有的武学，也据说，它能教天下之术！
如果这个少年真的是去雪月城的话，那么以他霹雳堂雷家子弟的身份，从雪月城中拿出百两银子自然不在话下。而这个家伙，似乎并不像在骗人。毕竟他怎么看，除了武功高强以外，简直就是一个傻子。
萧瑟心中琢磨了一番后点了点头，说道：“可以，但是我得跟你同去！”
雷无桀点点头：“可以！”
“还有。”萧瑟眼睛一转，嘴角露出一丝奸笑。
那些小二们顿时在心中替这个武功高强却单纯憨厚的少年叹了口气。
“事后还账，需要利息。我要五百两！”萧瑟朗声说道。
雷无桀顿时呆在了那里。

萧瑟则根本没有等他回应，轻轻一挥手，客栈的门顿时打了开来，他望着那漫天飞雪，轻轻叹了口气，低声地像是自言自语般地说道：“也是很多年没有走出去了。”
“来呀！备马！”
两匹骏马，一个穿着狐裘，整个人慵懒地窝在其中，另一个则只着红色单衣，在寒风中裸露着胸膛。两个人就这样在雪地里一路狂奔，冲着雪月城而去。
“你这马也是神骏，在这样的雪地中竟然也能自如奔驰！”雷无桀不由地赞叹道。
“五花马，千金裘！我萧瑟用的东西，只能是最好的。”萧瑟回头望了一眼他的客栈，在那里他留下了一笔钱让那些小二为他修整客栈，只等他从雪月城取了钱回来。可是萧瑟却隐隐地觉得，他或许永远也不会再回来了。
content_en:
The Lei family of Jiangnan Perak Hall has developed extremely lethal gunpowder for generations. In the early years, the ancestors performed a "sealing and hanging of swords" ceremony, determined to abandon these two most commonly used weapons in the martial arts world, and focus on the research of firearms, thus blazing a completely different path. Back then, no one thought that a family without swords could survive. But the Thunder Family of Perak Hall has done it. They have completely turned gunpowder into a weapon, making the impossible possible, and have become the most awe-inspiring family in the martial arts world.
"Since we have offended the Perak Hall, we also know that this matter cannot be resolved. Even if we are not opponents, we can't just sit back and wait for death!" The leader of the big man knew that the people of the Perak Hall would never show mercy to those who offended them, so he felt guilty and tightened the knife in his hand.
Lei Wujie smiled and shook his head: "I just sprinkled a few thunderbolts on that brother's knife. If you dare to be unreasonable again, then I will kill you..."
"Up!" The leader of the big man waved his sword, and the dozen or so people rushed forward.
"You!" Lei Wujie's eyes widened, "Aren't you afraid at all?"
Three knives had struck at Lei Wujie's head at the same time.
Lei Wujie was furious and swung his fists upward, breaking three steel knives with one punch, causing the three people to fly away.
"What a powerful gunpowder!" Everyone was shocked.
Lei Wujie said angrily: "It's not the gunpowder, it's my Wu Fang technique! Of course, if you want to see the gunpowder..." Lei Wujie jumped up, a black light flashed from his hand, and several marbles had been thrown down by him.
Only a few loud noises were heard, and the big men were blown up one by one. When they fell to the ground again, they were bleeding and could not stand up.
Lei Wujie fell from the air leisurely, with his hands behind his back: "How? Now we can
The big men were startled when they heard this, and looked at each other a few times. They thought that the young man would definitely take their lives, but based on his tone, it seemed that he would spare their lives.
"Go away yet! "Lei Wujie frowned. In his expectation, this group of people should have fled in a hurry at this time, but they looked like they were refusing to leave.
After hearing this, the big men hurriedly stood up with all their strength, and ran out one by one, supporting each other.
Lei Wujie nodded with satisfaction, found his package from the ruins of a pile of tables and chairs, put it on his back and prepared to leave. But a hand stopped him.
Lei Wujie looked up and saw the handsome boss, huddled lazily in the fox fur. He only stretched out his right hand and waved it lazily and slowly, blocking Lei Wujie's way.
Lei Wujie hurriedly clasped his hands: "Thank you for your kindness! When the road is rough, it is the right thing to draw your sword and help! There's no need to be too polite. I'm on my way in a hurry. I hope we'll see you soon! "
Xiao Se narrowed his eyes and frowned: "A big favor? No thanks? Draw a sword to help? "
Lei Wujie was also very confused: "If it weren't for me, those big guys would have robbed your store, and they might even have killed you. Isn't that a great favor? "
Xiao Se pointed at the pile of ruins and said angrily: "Look carefully! "
Lei Wujie turned around and looked around, only to see that a dozen tables of various sizes in the hall were blown to pieces, several waiters were also smashed to pieces, and even several holes were blown out of the ground.
Xiao Se pointed at the pile of ruins and said angrily: "Look at my store, it doesn't matter if it's been smashed! As for those people just now, did they want my life? snort! "
"This..." Lei Wujie's face turned red and he didn't know what to do for a moment.
"One hundred taels of silver. "Xiao Se stretched out his hand towards Lei Wujie. Those hands were white and flawless, with slender fingers, but in Lei Wujie's view, they were much more terrifying than the steel knives of those big men just now.
"I have no money! "Lei Wujie took a step back.
"Oh? "The bleak fox fur trembled slightly. He waved his hand gently, and the door of the entire inn closed in an instant.On.
"This skill..." Lei Wujie finally had to admit that those people just seemed to be unable to do anything to this enigmatic boss.
"But I will have this money soon!" Lei Wujie suddenly remembered something, his eyes lit up, and he said decisively.
"Oh?" Xiao Se still responded lazily, but his eyes could not help but look up and down at Lei Wujie's big baggage.
Lei Wujie continued: "I'm going to a place soon. When I get to that place, will I have money?"
"Where?"
"Xueyue City!" Lei Wujie said proudly.
"Xueyue City?" Xiao Se was also surprised when he heard this. Xueyue City is not a traditional sect in the world, it is more like an alliance, an organization jointly established by several sects and major families in the world! From the day Xueyue City appeared, the rules of the entire world were determined by it. Many of the young disciples from major sects of aristocratic families will go to Xueyue City to study. Due to years of operation, Xueyue City has become an independent force. It not only teaches martial arts that other sects do not have, but it is also said that it can teach the world's arts!
If this young man really goes to Xueyue City, then as a child of the Lei family of Perak Hall, it is not a problem to take out a hundred taels of silver from Xueyue City. And this guy doesn't seem to be lying. After all, how he sees it, apart from his martial arts prowess, he is simply a fool.
Xiao Se thought about it for a while and then nodded and said, "Okay, but I have to go with you!"
Lei Wujie nodded: "Okay!"
"Also." Xiao Se rolled his eyes and revealed a sinister smile at the corner of his mouth.
The waiters immediately sighed in their hearts for this young man who was highly skilled in martial arts but simple and honest.
"Repaying the debt later requires interest. I want five hundred taels!" Xiao Se said loudly.
Lei Wujie immediately stayed there.
Xiao Se didn't wait for his response at all. With a gentle wave of his hand, the door of the inn suddenly opened. He looked at the flying snow in the sky, sighed softly, and said in a low voice as if talking to himself: "I haven't gone out in many years."
"Come on! Prepare your horses!"
Two horses, one wearing a fox fur, resting lazily in it, the other wearing only a red singlet, bare chest in the cold wind. The two of them ran like this in the snow, heading towards Xueyue City.
"Your horse is also a divine horse. It can run freely in such snow!" Lei Wujie couldn't help but admire.
"Five-flowered horse, golden fur! The things I, Xiao Se, use can only be the best." Xiao Se looked back at his inn, where he left a sum of money for the waiters to repair the inn for him, just waiting for him to get the money back from Xueyue City. But Xiao Se had a vague feeling that he might never come back.
